Statements: No monkey is baboon. All baboons are donkeys. Conclusions: I. No donkey is monkey. II. Some donkeys are baboons.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

I. No donkey is monkey. → False (Because, only those part of Donkey that is Baboons are not Monkey, but no definite relation given between all Donkeys and Monkey, so it can be possible only).

II. Some donkeys are baboons. → True (Because, All Baboons are Donkeys gives some Donkeys are Baboons definitely).

Hence, only conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

No pen is a box.

Some pens are chalks.

All chalks are erasers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are pens - True (Because, Those erasers that is chalks will pen also).

II. Some chalks are not boxes - True (Because, Those part of Chalks that is pen will also not boxes).

III. Some boxes are not erasers - False (It may or may not be true cause it can also consider the part of pen which does not include eraser. So, it is indefinite conclusion).

So, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

Conclusions:

I. All whites are blacks → Does not follow (As no blue is white and no black is blue. So, it is possible but not definitely true therefore it does not follow)

II. No blue is black → Follow (As no black is blue. So, as there is direct negative or cross relation between blue and black therefore it is true)

III. Some whites are not blues → Follow (As no blue is white. So, as there is direct negative or cross relation between blue and white therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions II and III follow".
